company_name: WUHAN DR LASER TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
semiconductor_relevance: High — DR Laser specializes in high-precision laser processing equipment specifically for the semiconductor industry.
summary: Wuhan DR Laser Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading supplier of high-precision laser processing equipment tailored for the semiconductor sector. With over 7,000 machines shipped globally, the company focuses on innovative laser solutions to address manufacturing challenges in microfabrication and wafer dicing.

regional_presence.China: The corporate headquarters is located in Wuhan, China, at the heart of Optics Valley.
regional_presence.Israel: An overseas R&D center is established in Israel.
regional_presence.Singapore: The company has a direct subsidiary in Singapore.
